en.headline: CSRC and SFC announce new measures to deepen Hong Kong-Mainland market links
en.dek: The regulators unveiled 10 measures covering cross-boundary listings, ETFs, indices, RMB futures and professional qualifications to strengthen co-operation.
body: The China Securities Regulatory Commission and the Securities and Futures Commission announced on Monday a series of new measures aimed at further deepening practical co-operation and coordinated development between the Hong Kong and Mainland markets.

The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government welcomed the package, which covers cross-boundary listings, exchange-traded funds, index co-operation, renminbi-denominated futures products, streamlined applications for Mainland professional qualifications, and strengthened financial regulatory co-operation.

Chief Executive John Lee said the measures would support the development and cross-boundary financing of enterprises in Hong Kong and the Mainland, and further promote connectivity between the two markets. Financial Secretary Paul Chan noted that the steps would help investors seize opportunities arising from the Mainland’s economic development while consolidating Hong Kong’s role as a hub connecting the Mainland market and global capital.
The government said it and local regulators would actively facilitate the implementation of the measures.

zh.headline: 中證監與證監會公布深化兩地市場合作新措施
zh.dek: 監管機構公布十項措施，涵蓋跨境上市、ETF、指數合作、人民幣期貨及專業資格等範疇，加強兩地市場聯通。
body: 中國證券監督管理委員會與證券及期貨事務監察委員會星期一公布一系列新措施，進一步深化香港與內地市場的務實合作及協調發展。
香港特別行政區政府對有關措施表示歡迎。措施涵蓋跨境上市、交易所買賣基金、指數合作、人民幣計價期貨產品、簡化內地專業資格申請，以及加強金融監管合作等範疇。
行政長官李家超表示，有關措施將支持香港及內地企業的發展與跨境融資，並進一步促進兩地市場互聯互通。財政司司長陳茂波指，措施有助投資者把握國家經濟高質量發展帶來的機遇，同時鞏固香港作為連接內地市場與全球資本樞紐的功能。
政府表示，特區政府及本地監管機構將積極推動措施落實。
